items.title: General Mills (GIS) Shareholders Are Set To Vote On A Human Rights Proposal
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) faces a new shareholder proposal from a coalition of major institutional investors calling for greater transparency on human rights policies and supply chain practices ahead of its upcoming annual meeting. The investor group is urging fellow shareholders to back a resolution that would require expanded reporting on how General Mills identifies and manages human rights risks across its operations and global supplier base.
